name: biz-cdd
message: Beneficial-ownership (CDD) collection is incomplete: no owner crosses the 25% threshold and no control person is designated.

name: loan-dscr
message: DSCR is below the 1.20 minimum; a credit-committee waiver is required to fund.

name: loan-ltv
message: LTV exceeds the 0.80 ceiling; a credit-committee waiver is required to fund.

name: loan-sod
message: The same user originated and underwrote this loan — segregation of duties is violated.
rule_speak_override: A loan must not be funded by the same user who originated it: the originating relationship manager and the underwriter must be different users.

name: loan-watchlist
message: This loan is a classified asset or has a breached covenant but is not flagged on the watchlist.
